scope: Local hardening slice (PKG RC-33): the classifiers of the exposure register, builder, QR-3 comparison, QR-4 selection and multi-Pine member set extensions check the internal foreign-key triggers of their keys through the new shared module src/postgres/fk-trigger-inspection.js. No DDL or function body changed; a fresh install of every extension still classifies INSTALLED.
method: The QR-2 S4-1 review found that a classifier ignored disabled foreign-key triggers; root ruled the same check for every extension. A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote the shared module and the tamper tests; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed it and found that the set compare and the referenced-side flags had no test; root ruled; the coder added them; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each round. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, every test file that imports a changed module or runs a changed CLI of this batch (found with git grep): 13 PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (242 tests, 0 fail, 0 skipped), the full unit suite (2214 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped by platform gates, 9 todo) and the grant text test; every changed file had the same hash before and after. Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: The five extension PostgreSQL files pass with 0 skipped: exposure register 19, QR-3 comparison 20, QR-4 selection 17, member set 23, builder 27; a fresh install of each still classifies INSTALLED.

mutations.round1: 4 of 5 killed; the found-versus-wanted compare survived and got tests in round 2.
mutations.round2: 3 of 3 killed (set compare, trigger function compare, referenced-side deferrable flags).

limits: A database whose referenced base table has a disabled or altered foreign-key trigger now classifies these extensions OTHER and refuses install and rollback until it is repaired.
The QR-2 capital model keeps its own copy of the check.
No install or inspection was run on any environment.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted the foreign-key trigger hardening as local engineering evidence for the extension rows (F09-01, F10-02, F10-03, F11-01). Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
